newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end firm on borrowers' demand.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end firm on borrowers' demand.

text.p: Pakistani money rates ended firm on Thursday on increased demand from borrowers and dealers said they would remain high on Friday.

"The overnight market opened on a firm note. Early deals were done in the range of 15 to 16 percent. But later the rates went as high as 19.5 percent due to borrowing pressure," said a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank.
"At the end of the day, the market was seen more or less square," he added.
